newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle slip, feeders up to new highs.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle slip, feeders up to new highs.

text.p: CME live cattle futures opened mixed and then fell while feeder cattle opened up, quickly posting new contract highs.
Pressure from an overbought condition Friday weighed on live cattle despite some initial support.
Feeder cattle futures advanced to new highs, sparked by a USDA crop plantings report which pointed to possibly the second largest corn crop on record this year, traders said.
At 0908 CDT, live cattle stood 0.100 to 0.175 cent per lb lower with with June off 0.100 at 66.000 cents. Feeders were up 0.450 to 1.000 with August up most at 78.400, its new contract high.
